sam_ops: Quick flag  we had a small hiccup during the Q&A at ~18:10: brief slide jump and ~6s captions lag. Live stream stayed up. Can someone check the recorder and mark timestamps? @megan?

megan: On it. Recorder host is record07. I see two partial segments around 18:09:58-18:10:06. Splicing now. OBS switched to backup scene at 18:10:05.

ryan: Logs from record07 show a short CPU steal event then recorderd logged a recoverable write delay. Snippet: `[2026-04-02T18:10:00Z] recorderd WARN: segment write delayed (io wait)`. No full crash.

infra-bot: infra-alert: record07 experienced brief CPU steal (~1.5s) from host scheduler. No disk errors. Recommend pinning recorderd to isolated core for future events. Ticket INFRA-7502 created.

sam_ops: Good catch. Megan, please upload spliced files + iso to s3 and prefix any partial files with "partial-". Share link when ready.

megan: Uploading now: `aws s3 cp /mnt/recordings/record07/allhands-2026-04-02/ s3://redwood-archives/allhands/record07/ --recursive`  ETA ~2m. Will flag partials.

jen (CEO): Do not pause the Q&A. Keep collecting missed questions; I'll answer the top ones at the end. Comms, please prepare a short note saying a small clip may be incomplete.

qa-lyn: I'll scrape chat + Q&A doc for any questions between 18:09:50-18:10:10. Noted one audience Q about "roadmap migration sequencing" that likely fell in that window. I'll add to the follow-up list.

obs-bot: obs: switched scene to backup_live at 18:10:05Z and reduced output bitrate to 3500kbps to lower encoder load.

comm-lou: Thanks. Once S3 link is posted I'll send: "Recording available; a short segment ~18:10 may be incomplete. Full transcript will be provided." 

sam_ops: Action items: 1) megan upload spliced segments + iso to S3 and mark partials (ASAP), 2) postmortem draft (sam_ops) by EOD, 3) qa-lyn compile missed Qs and deliver to Jen + Comms in 45m, 4) infra to review CPU scheduling for record07. If anyone has local clips to preserve, paste S3 paths here. :thumbsup:
